components.name: Primary Return Link
components.description: The amber-filled return action at the end of the playoff page.
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: var(--touch-target-min); padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-focus); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-focus); color: var(--color-text-inverse); font: 0.875rem/1.3 var(--font-family-primary); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out), border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out); } .ds-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-focus) 85%, white); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent-primary) 72%, white); color: var(--color-text-inverse); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-primary[aria-disabled='true'] { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Secondary Return Link
components.description: The tonal back link above the playoff title.
components.css: .ds-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: var(--touch-target-min); padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--color-bg-tertiary); color: var(--color-text-primary); font: 0.875rem/1.3 var(--font-family-primary); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out), color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out); } .ds-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-bg-hover); color: var(--color-text-primary); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-secondary[aria-disabled='true'] { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-secondary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Team Theme Trigger
components.description: The masthead theme chooser, with its existing inline slider icon.
components.css: .ds-theme { position: relative; flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text-secondary); font: 0.8125rem/1.5 var(--font-family-primary); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s, background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-theme:hover, .ds-theme:focus-visible { color: var(--color-focus); background: var(--color-bg-hover); border-color: var(--color-focus); } .ds-theme:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-theme:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-theme-label { display: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-theme { transition: none; } }

components.name: Theme Reset
components.description: Label-only specimen of the theme reset control; its decorative refresh icon is omitted.
components.css: .ds-reset { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-default); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-bg-tertiary); color: var(--color-text-secondary); font: 0.8rem/1.5 var(--font-family-primary); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s; } .ds-reset:hover, .ds-reset:focus-visible { color: var(--color-focus); border-color: var(--color-focus); background: var(--color-bg-hover); } .ds-reset:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-reset:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-reset { transition: none; } }

components.name: Dialog Close
components.html: <button class="ds-close" type="button" aria-label="Close team picker"><svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 6 12 12M18 6 6 18"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-close { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 4px; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: transparent; color: var(--color-text-secondary); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s, background 0.15s; } .ds-close:hover, .ds-close:focus-visible { color: var(--color-text-primary); background: var(--color-bg-hover); } .ds-close:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-close:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-close { transition: none; } }

components.name: Masthead Help
components.description: The desktop masthead help button; the specimen omits its runtime visibility gate, not its placement.
components.css: .ds-help { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--color-bg-secondary); color: var(--color-text-secondary); font: 20px/1.5 var(--font-family-primary); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-help:hover { color: var(--color-focus); } .ds-help:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-help:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-help { transition: none; } }

components.name: Season Selector
components.description: A labeled native select; its initial loading option is copied from the template.
components.css: .ds-season { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: var(--font-family-primary); } .ds-season-label { color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-season-select { min-height: var(--touch-target-min); padding: 8px 32px 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-bg-secondary); color: var(--color-text-primary); color-scheme: dark; font: 1rem/1.5 var(--font-family-primary); } .ds-season-select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Bracketed View Navigation
components.description: A two-item excerpt of the desktop view rail; amber corner pairs mark the current view.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Main navigation"><button class="ds-tab ds-tab-active" type="button" aria-label="View League tab" aria-current="page">League</button><button class="ds-tab" type="button" aria-label="View Standings tab">Standings</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 14px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-default); } .ds-tab { position: relative; min-width: 100px; min-height: var(--touch-target-min); padding: 10px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text-secondary); font: 550 0.875rem/1.5 var(--font-family-primary); cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-tab:hover { background: var(--color-bg-secondary); color: var(--color-text-primary); } .ds-tab-active { background: var(--color-bg-secondary); color: var(--color-focus); } .ds-tab-active:hover { color: var(--color-focus); } .ds-tab::before, .ds-tab::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 8px; height: 8px; pointer-events: none; border-color: transparent; border-style: solid; transition: inset 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-tab::before { top: 0; left: 0; border-width: 1px 0 0 1px; } .ds-tab::after { right: 0; bottom: 0; border-width: 0 1px 1px 0; } .ds-tab-active::before, .ds-tab-active::after { border-color: var(--color-focus); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-tab, .ds-tab::before, .ds-tab::after { transition: none; } }

components.name: Playoff Status Tag
components.description: A labeled, non-interactive elimination state rather than a color-only cue.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 5px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-default); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text-primary); font: 0.6875rem/1.4 var(--font-family-primary); } .ds-status-eliminated { color: var(--color-accent-danger); }

components.css: .ds-field { min-width: 0; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-default); border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-bg-depth); color: var(--color-text-primary); font: 0.9375rem/1.5 var(--font-family-primary); } .ds-field-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 24px; } .ds-field-title { margin: 0 0 5px; font: 650 1.0625rem/1.25 var(--font-family-primary); text-wrap: balance; } .ds-field-status { display: grid; align-content: center; padding: 48px 24px; border: 0; text-align: center; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-field { padding: 20px 14px; } .ds-field-heading { align-items: flex-start; } }

narrative.overview:
A quiet, dark viewing field gives names and white readouts the foreground. Fine rules and corner brackets organize attention without decorative glow or a wall of elevated cards. The character is precise, compact, and clean.

The neutral palette is the default, not a replacement for team identity. Existing team themes remain available; independent amber focus cues keep controls recognizable. This records the built [tokens](lib/design-tokens.css), [main interface](lib/styles.css), [playoff interface](lib/playoff_styles.css), and their ERB/JavaScript controls. [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md) owns product constraints; route strategy lives in the surface brief.
keyCharacteristics: Dark tonal fields with white and gray readouts.
Independent amber focus; team identity remains customizable.
System sans names paired with tabular monospaced measurements.
Hairline structure, corner brackets, and restrained state transitions.

rules.name: The Stable Focus Rule
rules.body: Team themes may recolor surfaces and accents; selection brackets and keyboard focus retain the independent `--color-focus` token.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use system sans for names and controls, and tabular monospace for dedicated score, rank, and odds readouts.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Structural panels stay flat and hairline-bordered; shadows separate dialogs, not ranked teams or ordinary cards.

dos: **Do** preserve independent amber focus when applying team themes.
**Do** pair status color with readable labels and tabular numeric readouts.
**Do** keep mobile content clear of the bottom rail and masthead controls clear of the data field.
**Do** retain native controls, keyboard access, reduced-motion support, and honest empty/error states.
donts: **Don't** add decorative glow or turn ordinary data rows into elevated cards.
**Don't** replace missing records with zeroes, fabricated results, or unlabeled probabilities.
**Don't** turn retained chart-only fonts, legacy aliases, or one-off dimensions into global defaults.
